caption_en:
The line people hide behind in the group chat. 💬

Someone writes "Israel shouldn't exist", then "relax, it's just criticism." Here are the 11 words:

"Criticise any government you like. Nobody asks if France should exist."

📜 The International Holocaust Remembrance Alliance (IHRA) working definition of antisemitism (2016): "criticism of Israel similar to that leveled against any other country cannot be regarded as antisemitic." One of its examples of antisemitism: "Denying the Jewish people their right to self-determination."
🇮🇱 2023: Israelis protested their own government week after week over the judicial overhaul (Reuters, 2023).

Which sentence do you need most? Tell me below.

Part 2 of "Words for what you already feel". Part 3 on my profile.

Sources: IHRA working definition of antisemitism, 2016; Reuters, 2023.

caption_he:
המשפט שמתחבאים מאחוריו בקבוצת הווטסאפ.

מישהו כותב "לישראל אין זכות להתקיים", ואז "רגע, זו סתם ביקורת". הנה המשפט:
"תבקרו כל ממשלה שבא לכם. אף אחד לא שואל אם צרפת צריכה להתקיים."

📜 ההגדרה של IHRA לאנטישמיות (2016): ביקורת על ישראל כמו על כל מדינה אחרת היא לא אנטישמיות. שלילת הזכות של העם היהודי להגדרה עצמית היא אחת הדוגמאות לאנטישמיות.
🇮🇱 2023: ישראלים הפגינו נגד הממשלה שלהם, שבוע אחרי שבוע.

איזה משפט הכי חסר לכם? כתבו לי.

lines.line: Criticism, or asking if Israel should exist? Here's the difference, in 11 words.
A group chat. Someone writes: Israel shouldn't exist.
Then adds: relax, it's just criticism.
Nobody asks if France should exist.
The International Holocaust Remembrance Alliance agrees: criticising Israel like any other country is not antisemitic.
But denying the Jewish people the right to self-determination is.
And Israelis criticise their own government all the time. In 2023, they protested it week after week.
Save this. Criticise governments. Don't erase countries.
Which sentence do you need most? Tell me in the comments.
Criticism, or erasing a country? Now you can say the difference.
